items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t know if it was Garfinkel’s. No, it was something else.

ctx.x: I couldn’t speak of them, because I wasn’t there. Maybe like a Garfinkel’s, by the time I got there.
I don’t know if it was Garfinkel’s. No, it was something else. It was two other stores that I can’t think what the names of it was. Since then they turned them into something else.
Are there distinctions like, you could buy the clothes but couldn’t try them on?
